title: 第25章 目标 方寸山第26章 突破地仙中期
content_zh:
陆生看着面前这条气息强大的蛟龙，心中已经猜到对方身份。
敖正的母亲！
银白色蛟龙身形变化，化作一位身穿银色长裙的中年妇人。
见到这名中年妇人。
敖正元神像是做错事般低下头：
“娘亲！”
中年妇人冲到敖正元神面前，焦急道：
“正儿，你怎么会弄成这样的？”
听到中年妇人的话。
敖正一时语塞，不知该如何解释。
中年妇人心疼地看着敖正，泪流不止。
这时。
一旁的陆生看向中年妇人：
“伯母，抱歉！”
“敖兄是为了救我们，才遭了那狐妖毒手的。”
听到陆生的话。
中年妇人将目光看向他：
“你们又是何人？”
一旁的敖正元神，解释道：
“娘亲，他们是我的朋友！”

“之前多亏了他们，我才能够度过化形之劫。”
听到敖正的解释。
中年妇人目光变得缓和起来。
陆生则是有些愧疚道：
“伯母，敖兄肉身被毁，都是因我而起。”
“我定会想办法让敖兄恢复肉身。”
这时。
天空中的哪吒金身，叹了口气：
“小弟，此事怕是没有你想得这么容易！”
哪吒的话音落下。
众人都将目光看向他。
中年妇人行礼道：
“东海碧水海域之主，云姬，见过三太子！”
中年妇人，也就是敖正的母亲云姬。
正是附近这片“碧水海域”
之主。
境界在“玄仙”
巅峰！
只差一步，便能步入金仙之境！
可以说。

云姬的实力，在整个龙族中也排得上名号。
听到云姬的话。
哪吒眉头一挑！
content_en:
Lu Sheng looked at the powerful dragon in front of him and already guessed his identity.
Ao Zheng’s mother!
The body shape of the silver-white dragon changed and turned into a middle-aged woman wearing a silver dress.
Saw this middle-aged woman.
God Ao Zhengyuan lowered his head as if he had done something wrong:
"Mother!"
The middle-aged woman rushed to Ao Zheng Yuanshen and said anxiously:
"Zheng'er, how could you do this?"
I heard what the middle-aged woman said.
Ao Zheng was speechless for a moment and didn't know how to explain.
The middle-aged woman looked at Ao Zheng distressedly and shed tears.
At this time.
Lu Sheng on the side looked at the middle-aged woman:
"Aunt, I'm sorry!"
"Brother Ao was poisoned by the fox demon because he was trying to save us."
Hear what Lu Sheng said.
The middle-aged woman looked at him:
"Who are you?"
Ao Zheng Yuanshen on the side explained:
"Mom, they are my friends!"
"Thanks to them, I was able to survive the disaster of transformation."
Hear Ao Zheng's explanation.
The middle-aged woman's eyes softened.
Lu Sheng said a little guiltily:
"Auntie, Brother Ao's body was destroyed because of me."
"I will definitely find a way to restore Brother Ao's body."
At this time.
The golden body of Nezha in the sky sighed:
"Brother, I'm afraid this is not as easy as you think!"
Nezha's voice fell.
Everyone looked at him.
The middle-aged woman saluted and said:
"The Lord of the Blue Waters of the East China Sea, Yun Ji, has met the Third Prince!"
The middle-aged woman is Ao Zheng's mother Yun Ji.
It is this "clear water sea" nearby
Lord.
The realm is in "xuanxian"
Peak!
There is only one step left to enter the golden fairyland!
It can be said.
Yun Ji's strength ranks high among the entire dragon clan.
Hearing Yun Ji's words.
Nezha raised his eyebrows!
